svg.title: Eligibility, numerical agreement and observed execution are separate gates
svg.text: Three evidence gates before a useful performance claim
Device + target + interface + formats + shape + layout + alignment + collective rules.
Compare original-input and stored-input references; preserve C₀ and output identity.
Inspect actual matrix/scalar execution evidence; include required preparation and useful completion.
A requested library mode does not prove execution. A correct fallback can remain unclassified.
An instruction-level alignment rule is not a universal library dispatch rule.
